fishr.gradient_scope: shared x*(1+a)+b at a=b=0; virtual feature affine only, NOT backbone gradients
fishr.probe_CE_scope: all legal L through the SAME fixed auxiliary six-class linear head; not the full identity model CE
fishr.exact_target: per-day six-TX-uniform finite-L population gradient variance, then equal-RX centered squared deviation
fishr.sampling: independent A/B simple random samples without replacement within each cell; cross-batch overlap allowed
fishr.shuffled_control: permute RX only within same TX/day, preserve cell counts; compare against its own finite-population exact target
fishr.interpretation: Cross loss may be negative; no clipping/absolute value. Twelve rounds describe realized noise, not proof of unbiasedness.
